I've revamped the body and chat input styling in the spec to match your mockup; the code isn't changed yet. `piton check` finds no problems, formatting is clean, and `piton build` succeeded.

**What changes, in `ChatInputScope`** (`spec/scope/prompt-mode/chat-input/index.pi`):
- **Tab strip:** a flat 32 px strip on #222222 with no lines anywhere. Each tab is just its label in its mode's colour, with no border.
- **Selected tab:** marked only by its background, the same #333333 surface as the chat input area below it, so it reads as joined to it.
- **No mode tint:** the selected tab and the input area are no longer tinted by the mode. Only the tab labels and the Send button carry the mode colour.
- **Input box:** #111111, 4 px rounded corners, no border.
- **Buttons:** the column is 88 px wide (was 120), with buttons 8 px apart, flat, with 2 px corners.
  - **Send** has a paper-plane icon and a semibold label. It's a muted slate made from the mode's colour mixed into the base grey (about #3b4252 for Spec), instead of the full mode colour. It keeps its split chevron.
  - **Queue and Preview** are flat on #444444.
- **Chain:** it no longer has bottom-line rules, since the strip has no lines. Selecting it still joins Code and Spec under one background.

**In `BodyScope`** (`spec/scope/application/Body.pi`): the message list or open file sits on the flat #444444 base grey, edge to edge. The chat input is separated from it only by its darker tab strip.

**Things to check:**
- **Your own instruction changed.** Your `src/CLAUDE.md` rule, from `spec/shape/ChatInput.pi`, said Chain should have a bottom border in separate mode. A strip with no lines contradicts that, so I changed it to "no bottom border in either mode". Revert it if you want to keep that line.
- **What I didn't copy:** the mockup shows only Spec/Code/Ask/Agent, with no Chain tab, no Freeform, no help text and none of the right-hand controls. I read "roughly match this styling" as styling only, so I kept the existing tabs, modes and controls. If "Agent" is meant to replace Freeform, or Chain should go, tell me.
- **Pre-existing formatting problem:** the `tabs` section had a wrapped line starting `either:` that Piton read as a key. Fixing it made the section fold into a code block in the compiled reference. So I reworded that sentence and added a one-line intro under `tabs:`, which keeps each sub-section as its own heading.

**Anchors the code should follow:**
- **`ChatInputShape.description`:** the input box and button column.
- **`ChatInputShape.tabs.overview`, `.chain` and `.colour`:** the strip, labels, selection, no tint and the slate Send button.
- **`BodyShape.description`:** the base surface.
- **`ChatInputInstruction`:** no Chain border.
- **In the code, `src/chat_input.rs` is where most of this lives:**
  - the tab bar, and Chain's border handling;
  - `mode_tint`, where the body tint is applied;
  - `send_color`, which becomes the muted slate;
  - the button column's width and spacing.

content.text:
The chat input now has the flat look from your mockup. It builds without warnings and the chat input tests pass, but I haven't looked at it in the running app, so treat the exact colours as untuned.

- **Tab strip:** a flat 32 px strip on #222222 with no lines at all. Each tab is just its label in its mode's colour, and hovering an unselected tab lightens it a little.
- **Selected tab:** marked only by a #333333 background, the same as the input area below, so the two read as one piece. When Chain is selected, Code and Spec share one background with the chain icon on top.
- **No mode tint:** the input area is no longer tinted by the mode; the mode shows only in the tab labels and the Send button.
- **No line above the chat input:** the darker strip is what separates it from the message list.
- **Input box:** #111111, 4 px corners, no border.
- **Buttons:** the column is 88 px wide, buttons 8 px apart, with 2 px corners.
  - **Send** keeps its icon and split chevron, with a semibold label. It's now a muted slate: the mode's hue at a quarter of its saturation, near the base grey (about #3b4252 for Spec), with normal text colour.
  - **Queue and Preview** are flat on the base grey (#444444), a step lighter on hover.

**How it's built:** the tabs are now plain elements of my own rather than gpui-kit's tab bar, because gpui-kit's tabs draw their own borders and backgrounds. That let me remove the border-hiding workarounds around Chain (`seam`, `chain-gap-line`, `SEAM_COVER_REACH`). The chain's slide-together animation is unchanged. The changes are in `src/chat_input.rs`.

**Tests:** four tests described the old look, and I rewrote them to the new spec:
- the send-colour test now checks for a muted slate of the mode's hue;
- the two Chain-line tests (one in `chat_input.rs`, one in `main_window.rs`) now check there's no line under Chain in either mode;
- the Chain spacing test no longer checks the removed seam cover.

All 31 chat input tests pass. The full suite has 6 failures:
- Four were failing before this work: the three prompt-wording tests and `code_tasks_sent_to_spec_are_told_what_the_code_task_did`.
- `stopping_a_run_ends_its_harness_at_once` passed when I reran it on its own.
- `selected_answer_text_can_be_copied_or_attached` has been intermittent all session; I didn't rerun it this time.

**Where the spec and your prompt disagree, I followed the spec.** Your mockup shows only Spec, Code, Ask and Agent. I kept Code, Chain, Spec, Ask and Freeform, plus the help text and right-hand controls, and changed only the styling. Your `src/CLAUDE.md` rule now matches the spec: no line under Chain in either mode.

The constraints are in `.suspense/history/1790714216-Prompt_603e5f7555fa1433.understanding.md`.
